## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows the Godot style guide; script files use snake_case names
- [ ] gdlint passes; no errors in the Godot Output panel or browser console
- [ ] No test cases removed; coverage not reduced
- [ ] New files carry the PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 header
- [ ] JS/web bridge code stays test-only and isn't added to the production build
- [ ] If export presets changed: the `Web` preset still has thread support on
- [ ] Milestone note added under `files/docs/milestones/<milestone>/`
